summary: Full E2E testing of JKHive Deliveries (Goods-In) wizard. Backend: 16/16 pytest passed in 2.95s — auth gates (401/403) on all 4 endpoints, suppliers CRUD (list/create/sorted/delete/404), records CRUD with auto chilled_pass (≤8°C) + frozen_pass (≤-18°C) logic verified across 3 cases (4°C → chilled only, -19°C → both, 12°C → out of range), _id excluded from all responses, recorded_at desc sort verified, empty-name 400. Frontend (mobile 414×896): logged in as admin@jollys.com, dismissed location bottom-sheet by clicking Timperley, clicked tile-deliveries → /delivery-records → Add new delivery → supplier picker (empty hint 'No suppliers yet' shown) → Add Supplier (all 8 type options confirmed: general/fishmonger/butcher/greengrocer/bakery/wine merchant/alcohol supplier/other) → Save → auto-routed to /item (item picker), searched 'chicken', selected 'chicken (breast)' → /record (both Chilled and Frozen recommended-range labels visible, set 4°C) → Next → /comment, entered comment → Submit → 'Delivery saved!' success → Done → back to /delivery-records, row visible with CHILLED OK pill + delete button. Routines tile badge updated from blank to '1' after submission. All test data cleaned up (1 record + 1 supplier deleted via API).
critical_code_review_comments: deliveries.py routes: clean implementation, auto-pass logic correct, _id consistently excluded — no issues.
Minor: supplier_name on record is denormalised at write time; if a supplier is renamed later, historical records keep the old name (acceptable, but worth a one-line comment in code).
Minor: PickSupplier delete trash icon is a <span> with an onClick rather than a <button> — works, but for a11y a real button with type=button would be cleaner.

Routines.jsx: deliveriesTodayCount badge uses fixed blue (#0A84C9). Spec says 'live badge equal to today's records count' — verified working. Consider also colouring red if any out-of-range record exists today (parity with cooling worstStatus pattern).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — full wizard flow + tile badge + delete row working

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up: 1 TEST_ supplier ('TEST_E2E Supplier' butcher) and 1 chicken delivery record at 4°C with comment 'e2e test comment' on location 'timperley-altrincham'. Cleanup verified deleted 1 record + 1 supplier. Tile badge stays at 0 for next run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deliveries wizard (5 steps: supplier → item → temp gauge → comment → submit) is fully working backend + frontend. Critical insight for any jkhive testing: the LocationContext bottom-sheet [data-testid='jkhive-location-sheet'] auto-opens on first jkhive visit and intercepts pointer events on tiles. Either pre-set localStorage 'admin.locationId' AND click a location row in the sheet to dismiss, OR add force=True is NOT enough (overlay still blocks). Existing tiles (cooking-cooling, reheating, cooked, checklists, opening, closing) were observed rendering with correct data-testids on the routines page screenshot — no regression observed.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All 16 backend tests + complete 5-step UI wizard verified.
